review_candidates.title: Consultant for Strengthening approaches to prevent GBV and child marriage among adolescents
review_candidates.description: Job Description Purpose of consultancy: The consultant will undertake a comprehensive multi-country review of prevention interventions for child marriage and GBV among adolescents in Cambodia, Lao PDR and the Philippines, with concrete recommendations on how to strengthen them and how to measure their impact. The analysis will examine how global guidance has been adapted at the country level; identify opportunities to strengthen programming that prevents GBV and child, early and forced marriages among adolescents. How you can make a difference: UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies. In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction. UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results Scope of work: UNFPA’s Strategic Plan (2026–2029) aims to accelerate the implementation of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) Programme of Action through four transformative outcomes: Accelerated progress on meeting the unmet need for family planning. Accelerated progress on ending preventable maternal deaths. Accelerated progress on ending gender-based violence and harmful practices, including child marriage. Strengthening societal resilience by adapting to demographic change through evidence-based policies. Outcome 3 of the Strategic Plan directly responds to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Target 5.3 to eliminate all harmful practices, such as child, early, and forced marriage (CEFM) and female genital mutilation (FGM). Despite recorded global progress, East Asia and the Pacific remain home to 95 million women and girls married before the age of 18. The 2026–2029 Strategic Plan strongly emphasizes integrated programming that bridges humanitarian and development actions. This integration ensures that support structurally reaches the most vulnerable populations navigating an era of global polycrisis. UNFPA addresses GBV and harmful practices through policy advocacy, research, and programming, and recognizes the growing role of digital platforms in both delivering education and exposing girls to new forms of risk. In line with this vision, UNFPA APRO seeks an Individual Consultant to support: Desk Review: The consultant will commence with a comprehensive desk review with a focus on literature that showcases key drivers for child marriage and GBV as well as specific prevention interventions to address these drivers in Cambodia, Lao PDR and the Philippines. This activity will involve reviewing national policies, curricula, and program documents to understand how these interventions are designed and implemented to address the specific drivers of child marriage and GBV. The desk review will also aim to identify promising practices and gaps in current approaches in the country context, as feasible. Stakeholder Engagement and Data Collection: The consultant will develop data collection tools and will work with a team of national consultants in each country to gather the data. This phase will involve in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with organisations involved in child marriage and GBV prevention. These data collection activities will provide valuable insights into the challenges and opportunities associated with prevention interventions for child marriage and GBV among adolescents. Gap Analysis, Opportunity Identification, Formulation of Recommendations: Based on the comprehensive review, the consultant will conduct a gap analysis to identify opportunities for enhancing programming and formulate evidence-based recommendations and strategic interventions to enhance programming and their monitoring and evaluation. Development of country-specific Roadmaps to guide COs in the rollout of recommendations and the measurement framework for impact Duration and working schedule: The total duration of the consultancy will be 70 working days between 1st December 2026 - 31 October 2027 (11 months). The selected consultant will develop a workplan in consultation with the UNFPA APRO GBV team. Place where services are to be delivered: Services will be delivered on a home-based arrangement. Delivery dates and how work will be delivered: By 31 January 2027: Inception Report detailing the literature review findings, data collection methodology, work plan, ToRs for national consultants and timeline for data collection should be delivered. (estimated 20 workdays) By 30 April 2027: Draft Report outlining preliminary findings on the gap analysis and opportunities identification should be delivered. (estimated 20 workdays) By 15 October 2027: below deliverables should be received. (estimated 30 workdays) Final Report presenting a comprehensive analysis with case studies and actionable recommendations for strengthening programming. A regional webinar or dissemination event to share findings with UNFPA APRO, Country Offices, and partners, facilitating dialogue on next steps 3 country- specific roadmaps with actionable interventions to rollout the recommendations and at least 2 follow-up meetings with each COs to guide the rollout. A work plan/delivery monitoring schedule will be determined by APRO and the Consultant at the outset of the consultancy. A tracking sheet will be used to note progress against the TOR deliverables and deadlines The payment will be made on deliverables basis and upon acceptance by UNFPA APRO. Supervisory arrangements: The consultant will report to the UNFPA APRO GBV Advisor. Expected travel: Travel to UNFPA Country Offices will be anticipated depending on requests. Specific travel dates and durations will be determined in consultation with the relevant Country Offices. Travel expenses will be covered by UNFPA in accordance with the travel policy. Required expertise and qualifications: Education: Advanced university degree (Master’s or higher) in social sciences, gender studies, public health, education, or a related field. Professional Experience And Required Skills At least seven years of relevant experience in research or programming on comprehensive sexuality education, GBV, and/or harmful practices. Demonstrated experience in policy analysis, qualitative research, and stakeholder engagement in the Asia Pacific region. Familiarity with global and regional frameworks on CSE, GBV prevention, and harmful practices. Excellent analytical, writing, and presentation skills. Excellent research and interviewing skills Strong writing and documentation skills Proficiency in English. Inputs / services to be provided by UNFPA The consultant will use their personal laptop/computer. UNFPA APRO will link the consultant to Country Office Gender/GBV focal points wherever necessary. UNFPA Work Environment: UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more. Disclaimer: Selection and appointment may be subject to background and reference checks, medical clearance, and other administrative requirements. UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts. Our partner is looking for a Communications and Social Media Manager based in Brazil. We are seeking an experienced communications professional to shape brand messaging and strengthen audience engagement across digital and media channels. In this fully remote role, you will develop compelling content, manage online communities, coordinate press communications, and lead strategic campaigns that increase awareness of products and initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, design, legal, customer support, and leadership, to deliver consistent and impactful communications. The role offers significant ownership, allowing you to manage projects from initial planning through execution, measurement, and post-campaign analysis. You will use audience insights and performance metrics to refine strategies and identify new opportunities for engagement. This is an opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven technology environment that values trust, inclusivity, autonomy, and clear communication. Manage social media mentions, online communities, and audience interactions across platforms such as X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky. Plan and coordinate proactive announcements, product launches, and communications campaigns across press, social media, and community channels. Manage incoming press requests, pitch relevant stories to journalists, and build and maintain strong media relationships. Lead social media and communications projects from initial scoping and planning through execution, performance evaluation, and post-project reviews. Develop and maintain content calendars, coordinate approval workflows, and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders. Track and analyze social and earned media performance, including reach, engagement, sentiment, and campaign impact. Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights, recommendations, and opportunities to improve future communications. Ability to translate performance data into clear reports, strategic insights, and practical recommendations. Deep understanding of online culture, digital communities, and audience behavior, with sound judgment in managing public conversations. The CFO will play a central role in supporting business growth, financial stability, and strategic investment decisions within the renewable energy and solar infrastructure sectors. Working closely with executive leadership, the CFO will oversee financial planning, accounting, treasury, financial risk management, project financing, and financial governance while supporting business development and potential international expansion initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong financial leadership with experience in renewable energy, infrastructure investment, project finance, corporate finance, or international business operations . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the company's overall financial strategy and long-term financial plan. Lead corporate finance, financial planning and analysis, treasury, accounting oversight, and financial reporting. Oversee annual budgets, financial forecasts, cash-flow projections, and financial performance analysis. Develop capital allocation strategies supporting business growth, operational investments, and strategic projects. Evaluate financing structures for renewable energy and solar infrastructure projects. Lead relationships with banks, institutional investors, lenders, and strategic financial partners. Support project financing, debt financing, equity financing, and capital-raising initiatives. Oversee liquidity management, working capital, cash-flow planning, and treasury operations. Establish and maintain financial controls, governance policies, and risk-management frameworks. Ensure financial reporting processes comply with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Evaluate investment opportunities, project economics, financial returns, and potential business acquisitions. Partner with operations and project development teams to monitor project budgets, capital expenditures, and financial performance. Support financial planning and risk assessments for cross-border business activities. Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and performance dashboards to support executive decision-making. Oversee financial due diligence related to partnerships, investments, financing, and strategic transactions. Identify financial risks associated with interest rates, currency exposure, liquidity, and project execution. Collaborate with legal, compliance, tax, operations, and business development teams on financial matters. Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing finance organization. Present financial results, forecasts, investment recommendations, and strategic financial insights to executive leadership. Qualifications 12+ years of progressive experience in corporate finance, financial management, investment banking, project finance, accounting, treasury, or related disciplines. Significant executive leadership experience as a Chief Financial Officer, VP of Finance, Finance Director , or comparable senior financial executive. Strong expertise in financial strategy, capital planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. Experience within renewable energy, solar energy, infrastructure, utilities, energy investment, or project-based businesses is highly valued. Strong understanding of project finance, investment evaluation, financial risk management, and corporate treasury. Experience with international operations, cross-border financing, or multinational financial reporting is preferred. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP, IFRS, or other applicable financial reporting standards. Experience overseeing financial controls, external audits, and financial governance. Strong analytical judgment, commercial awareness, negotiation skills, and executive leadership capabilities. Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related discipline. MBA, CPA, CFA, or another relevant professional qualification is preferred. Preferred Experience Corporate Finance · Renewable Energy · Solar Infrastructure · Project Finance · Capital Planning · Financial Strategy · Treasury · Investment Analysis · Financial Risk Management · International Finance · Financial Reporting · Business Growth What We're Looking For We are looking for a financial executive who can combine strategic financial leadership, investment expertise, disciplined financial management, and strong commercial judgment .
